notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.7_3
notes.notes:

• Fixed tutorial getting stuck in the Fishing Village (in some special cases).
• Fixed the chisel mission not being completable when starting a new game or replaying the mission.

• Updated fishing conditions (now requires both a fishing rod and bait;  previously, only bait was required).
• Fixed weekend pop-up getting stuck when pressing ESC.
• Fixed satisfaction bar being hidden when Romantic content is enabled.
• Fixed girl profile info not unlocking after reaching the required affection level.
• Fixed gallery files now saved in the same level save folder as save slots, making them easier to locate.
• Fixed some conversations.
• The weekend event skip pop-up is now hidden after the event ends.
• Updated activity tutorial (no longer forces players to click exactly on the highlighted spot).

notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.5_2
notes.notes:
[p]This is the most ambitious and heartfelt game we've ever created, and throughout development, we faced many challenges. As an indie team working on a game packed with new and risky features, there were many things we simply couldn't anticipate. We also lacked the experience to accurately predict a solid release date.[/p][p][/p][p]Even though there were still potential bugs, we decided not to delay the release any further after already missing our promised launch date twice. At that point, many fans were urging us to release the game quickly, even though we personally wanted a bit more time to test the closed beta more thoroughly.[/p][p][/p][p]Still, we didn’t want to let the community down, so we made the tough decision to release and collect feedback to fix and improve the game over time. [b]Right now, the game is in a fairly stable state.[/b] The early stages might feel a bit slow, but we hope you'll be patient. Once you get the hang of it, we believe you'll really enjoy it and feel the passion and care we've poured into every part of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re committed to continuing to improve the experience based on your feedback.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/18906d5b46af930fb2ef98eefe2ebddec2809c13.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed UI stretching issue for Liu Yalin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issue for collection items on the phone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where unlocked texting images weren't showing in the phone collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated missing texting images for Qin Yilin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Liu Yalin appeared on the minimap, but her room didn’t show up in the area.[/p][/*][*][p]Previously, if you completed a level but hadn’t finished the task, the next task wouldn’t allow claiming the reward right away (you had to wait until the next session). Now, if you meet the conditions, you can claim the next reward immediately after completing the task.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the mission count display for side girls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect unlock info display in the Gallery.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bonus level not functioning properly when re-entering the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Days of the week (Monday–Sunday) have been localized for all supported languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Recipes can no longer be sold to avoid bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Item title and description now display properly in the inventory. Item quantities are now shown in shop descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Lock passwords are now easier to read.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the merge UI to handle large quantities (more than 2 items).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI for stamina and fortitude display in the menu before entering “Socialize.”[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted text color for the Immunity stat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Make sure you are playing on the latest version: 1.0.5_2[/b] Please ensure your game is up to date on Steam.[/p][p]

notes.title: 🥹Release Delayed — A Heartfelt Apology & a Small Gift for our beloved community
notes.notes: [h3][b][u]New Release Date[/u][/b]: [b]4:00 AM, 18 July (Pacific Time)[/b][/h3][p]—just a little longer, but we promise it will be worth the wait.[/p][p][/p][p]———[/p][h3][b]🤗 To Our Wonderful Community,[/b][/h3][p]We’re truly sorry for the delay in releasing [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i]. Over the past weeks, we’ve received so many messages from you saying how long you’ve been waiting for the release, and we’re deeply grateful for that anticipation and support. Your patience, encouragement, and trust mean the world to us—they inspire us every day to make our games better and more polished.[/p][p]We are deeply grateful for the incredible support from our beta testing group, who are loyal members of our community. They have worked diligently throughout the beta phase, sharing creative ideas and providing valuable feedback.[/p][p]The great news is that our beta testers have given high praise to the refined gameplay mechanics and enhanced graphics in [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i], highlighting them as major improvements over our previous titles. However, there are still some bugs that need to be addressed to make your first experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/d85d555fe027cff1653d57654c4fffd94fff455c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]❓Why the Delay?[/b][/h3][p]Compared to our previous games, [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i] has a much larger scope—more story branches, more CGs, more events, and more… well, everything.[/p][p]That means:[/p][p]• A huge script size with complex multilingual syncing.[/p][p]• A few remaining bugs that might frustrate early players.[/p][p]• The user experience still needs improvement to ensure it doesn’t impact gameplay.[/p][p]• Helpful feedback from beta testers gave us a list of usability improvements we’d love to implement before release.[/p][p]🥹 Although our team has been working 12+ hours a day to test and polish everything, the workload has been heavier than expected, with some changes and challenges beyond our control.[/p][p]✨ On the bright side, our art team has used this extra time to create even more beautiful illustrations for you to enjoy in the final game![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎁 A Small Gift While You Wait[/b][/h3][p]To express our gratitude and hopefully brighten your wait, we’re sharing an exclusive, high-resolution illustration of one of the heroines. Feel free to download it, set it as your wallpaper, or simply keep it as a token of our appreciation.[/p][p]➡️ [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pJiqcCRn2oo1OylcDJ9qUEbUXBa9YAxl?usp=sharing"]Happy Teacher's Wallpapers[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and unwavering support. We can’t wait to share the finished game with you! [/p][p][/p][p]With love 💕,[/p][p]Reborn Entertainment Team.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 [b]Wishlist [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i][/b] now if you haven’t already![/p][p]🗓️ Mark your calendar for [b]4:00 AM, July 18th (Pacific time)[/b], you won’t want to miss your next study session with these irresistible ladies and the Big Discount of 30%.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/"][/dynamiclink]Join the vibrant Reborn community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/zHrRdQDYfn"]Discord[/url], connect with other players, share your ideas, and become part of our growing community. If you want to support us, please click "Follow" on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RbA"]Our Developer Page[/url]   [/p]

notes.title: 💖 A Heartfelt Update from the Reborn Team 💖
notes.notes: [p]Hey Talented Students![/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that Love n Life: Happy Student is now in its final stretch! Our whole team is working tirelessly on the last crucial steps, QA, bug fixes, and polishing every detail, to make sure you get the best possible experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We faced some tough times and delays during Lucky Teacher's release, but your support has kept us going. Thank you for sticking with us. We promise the wait this time will be worth it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/132d05cbe56e4ff2a175cb6a6038591a141dfa2b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, releasing during the 2025 Steam Summer Sale would mean competing with major titles and heavy discounts, which could hurt our visibility. [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i], a game we’ve poured our hearts into, deserves the best chance to shine.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f4086e462869f8982afccd48647db16ddab6db08.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]💡 Games Made with Heart[/h3][p]At Reborn, our mission is simple: to deeply understand our community and keep innovating to bring you fresh, meaningful experiences. Our games have always stood out for their unique gameplay and storytelling, even if our graphics still have room to grow.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe anime dating games can offer more: more heart, more innovation, more freedom, and more memorable experiences. That’s why we focus on crafting fun gameplay, deep stories, and unique characters that let you slow down, explore, and truly connect.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re committed to creating a truly immersive experience. We’re tackling these challenges head-on, not just in our current games, but in every game we make moving forward. Our goal is to deliver something genuinely different: games where your choices matter, where stories and characters feel alive, and where you can truly unwind and enjoy yourself.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly proud to share that after our recent wishlist campaign, Love n Life: Happy Student has reached [b]51,941 wishlists[/b], a huge leap from Lucky Teacher’s 40,000 at launch! This amazing milestone is a testament to your support and shows us we’re on the right path. The whole team is buzzing with excitement as we approach our launch.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/9ab609d5c90557593c6a342ff8195941a75a5324.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🌱 Growing Together, Dreaming Bigger[/h3][p]We’re still a young team, and every project is a leap of faith. A single misstep on a major game could stretch our resources thin. That’s why we’ve learned to be patient with our key future projects.[/p][p][/p][p]Every sale helps us grow: it means more resources, more experience, and the chance to bring even more talented people onto our team. We know the demo still has a few rough edges, and that some game design elements were intentionally left unbalanced so you could explore and unlock more content freely. Rest assured, the full release will be carefully balanced and polished to deliver the best experience possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. Your support means everything, and together, we’re building something truly special.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/0be4b6be9a277cf8ccca32c88cc5b4299285c590.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Please wishlist our game if you haven’t already. Mark your calendar for the [b]exciting release of Love n Life: Happy Student on July 11th,[/b] it’s just around the corner! And join the vibrant Reborn community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/zHrRdQDYfn"]Discord[/url], connect with other players, share your ideas, and become part of our growing community. If you want to support us, please click "Follow" on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RbA"]Our Developer Page[/url] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to keep supporting our previous games as they contribute directly to the rich content we’re creating for the future![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21300/Love_n_War/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Official Release Date! - Mark Your Calendar
notes.notes:
[p]We understand you’re eager to dive into the beautiful world of Love n Life: Happy Student. We would love to deliver it to you as soon as possible in June. However, after the latest public demo update, while everyone enjoyed it, we also received valuable feedback that helped us realize there’s still more work to do to meet your expectations. Therefore, we’ve decided to move the launch date to July 11. We sincerely apologize for this unexpected delay.[/p][p][/p][p]Above all, we never want to provide you with an incomplete experience because you deserve our very best and unwavering effort. Please continue to follow our updates, and know that the wait will be worth it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/8539119f5072af86f9bbf3c8d60828f25a9a73a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to change the old release date on our Steam page, but Steam requires their approval for any updates. We’ll publish the new date once it has been approved.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/d4c4544c1b6a22b639eea4307fd5aa5f3ba31f4c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
